notes: FIX: A CHANGE TYPED ON THE NUMBER PAD AND SAVED WITHOUT TAPPING DONE WAS DROPPED. Reported: rent set to 0 from 2027-03, nothing showed when previewing. Cause, introduced in v2026.11.11.04: the editor treated an amount as an untouched default unless an 'input' event had fired on it, and dropped untouched defaults on save. The app's number pad writes digits with no event until Done or a tap outside, and a tap on a button such as Save Scenario does not count as outside. So C, 0, Save left the row flagged untouched, it was dropped, and the scenario was saved with no changes. Reproduced in headless Chromium: saved changes [] and zero effect; the same steps with Done in between saved newAmount 0 and cut Mar 2027 expenses by Rs 42,405. FIXES: (1) a row is a default only while its value still equals the number the editor filled in (data-rv-default), decided by value, not by events; (2) Save Scenario first finishes an open number pad exactly as Done does, so a typed sum like 40000+5000 is resolved (45000) instead of read raw and lost; this applies to every scenario type; (3) a Change my plan scenario that would end up with no changes is not saved: the editor stays open and says why. Scenarios already saved empty by the bug show 'no changes' in the list and must be re-entered. VERIFIED: C, 0, Save now stores the change; previewing it, the Projection sheet in its default window (Nov 26 to Oct 27) shows the row 'Change my plan . Revise Rent & Maintenance to 0 from 2027-03' with nothing in Feb 27, -Rs 42,405 in Mar 27 and -Rs 44,949 in Oct 27 after the May step-up, and Total Expenses in Mar 27 is exactly Rs 42,405 lower than without preview. Regression: engine with no scenarios identical to v2026.05.13.03; 32 engine assertions, 15 editor-vs-sheet checks and 6 number-pad checks pass; no page errors. NOTE ON DISPLAY: like every scenario type, a revision shows as its own italic row in the expenses section with the change (here -42,405); the Rent & Maintenance row itself keeps showing the base plan. NOT VERIFIED: the guards sheetVsDash, decisionUsesChain, instrumentCrossPageMismatch and accountDeltaMismatches are not in the HTML file and were not run. NOT BUILT: closed-EMI zero row; settlement on its own line; Edit balances port and Instruments page deletion; Decisions/Scenarios merge.
